chapter: Cabarets and the Red Light District
title: Cabaret ticket dances and the girls' pay
summary: How the cabaret ticket system worked, what the girls earned, and where the cabaret was.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well back in those days that's just where the cabarets used to run, but still in buying the tickets from the girls, you'll buy them a drink. See that's the cabaret I was playing. You buy them a drink, well a bottle of beer was 25 cents. Well the house made 15 cents. See they tied that ticket in half. She gets a dime.

See she gets a dime. She don't get paid away this cabaret. She gets a dime. I think she gets something like 25 or 50 cents a night. Good cabaret, they keep the good girls there. They pay them, you know, like 50 cents a night.
Where was this cabaret that you worked at?
Across the Malls and Liberty. Yeah.
